name: Groves Chemist
improvements: Replace the dynamic "Open today until 6.00pm" strip with sourced branch hours from the archived site or NPN listing.
Add pharmacy frontage or dispensary photography when a publishable image becomes available.
summary: Groves Chemist restores the repeat-prescription capability the pharmacy's own deactivated site used to carry, with services, surgeries and delivery area drawn from archived groveschemist.com structure and trading confirmed on 24 July 2026. The main action was an inert "Send to the pharmacy" link that implied a live submission; it now validates the form and shows an honest prototype handoff with a branch phone link, and an unsourced text-confirmation line was removed from the emergency notice.
verificationNote: Trading confirmed 24 July 2026; prescription services and the BT30/BT33 collection area match the pharmacy's archived site structure.

retirement.reason: The pharmacy's live domain serves the deactivation notice of a centralised platform: "This website is no longer available, If you are the pharmacy owner, please contact The Pharmacy Centre to re-activate." What was switched off was The Pharmacy Centre / Medicine Chest product — accounts, health records, an 8,000-item shop — not something Groves built. The design task was written as "restore the capability that was switched off", which presumes the pharmacy wants it back. The only thing the evidence establishes is that it stopped. Rebuilding a centralised pharmacy platform for a business that came off one is proposing work they have already declined, and we do not know whether they opted out, let it lapse, or had it retired for them.
retirement.evidence: The 24 July 2026 before capture of the deactivation notice was removed from public/ with this retirement. It remains retrievable at commit dc87b15 — public/images/groves-chemist-before.jpg.
